messages:
Maya: Quick sync — we need a small 'marketplace IaC cheatsheet' + example Terraform modules for AWS/GCP/Azure so partners can onboard faster. Who can own the modules and the one-page refarch checklist?

Eli: I can own the Terraform modules. thinking: a mono-repo like `marketplace-iac/` with submodules `aws/`, `gcp/`, `azure/`. keeps PRs small. question: do we need to publish to Terraform Registry or just reference GH modules for now?

Riley: +1 mono-repo. For infra notes: include VPC layout, NAT/egress patterns, required IAM roles, and recommended instance types for inference. Also note KMS/HSM requirements for Private customers.

Sam: Timeline check — product wants a minimal AWS example for the partner launch on 04/22. Can we do AWS-first (minimal viable) and then GCP/Azure followups? Also need a short checklist for marketplace listing (images, manifest, security docs).

Eli: AWS-first is doable. Plan: deliverables for AWS MVP (by 04/15): 1) terraform module that spins up a small demo stack (VPC, subnet, ecs/ec2 for inference, security groups), 2) README + usage snippet, 3) simple smoke test. After that, GCP/Azure ports.

Riley: For the smoke test, we should run an end-to-end: deploy -> curl /health -> run a small generation workload to validate latency and KV cache mounting. Add an IAM policy template to avoid overprivileges.

Eli: sample usage snippet for AWS module (will expand):

```hcl
module "redwood_marketplace_aws_demo" {
  source = "github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-iac//aws"
  name   = "redwood-demo"
  region = "us-west-2"
  instance_type = "g5.2xlarge"
  ami_id = var.ami_id
}
```

Maya: That snippet looks good — include an outputs block for `load_balancer_dns` and `instance_role_arn`. Add a short `variables.tf` example and a note about how to pass secrets (dont hardcode keys; use SSM/KMS).

Sam: Also need a short README template for marketplace docs — one-paragraph architecture, prerequisites, deploy steps, testing, and known limitations. Can someone draft the README template so partners can copy it?

Eli: I'll draft README + Terraform examples. Can someone own the acceptance criteria checklist and security review?

Riley: I'll own the checklist/security bits. Items I'll include: least-priv IAM, KMS integration, ingress-only LB rules, VPC endpoints for S3, audit logs enabled, and a short runbook for scaling.

Maya: Great. Action items: @Eli -> draft module + README (PR to `marketplace-iac/aws` by 04/05). @Riley -> security checklist + CI smoke test definition (by 04/08). @Sam -> consolidate marketplace listing requirements and legal contact info. I'll open a GH issue with the template and set a weekly 30m sync starting next Tues.

MarketplaceBot: New issue created: redwood-inference/marketplace-iac#42 (marketplace IaC cheatsheet kickoff) — https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-iac/issues/42

Eli: quick q on tests — do we have a sandbox AWS account for automated runs? If not, I'll wire instructions for manual deployment.

Riley: we have `sandbox-marketplace` account. I'll add CI creds to vault and a short script `ci/deploy-smoke.sh` that the test harness can call.

Sam: Perfect. If everyone hits their dates we should have an AWS example + checklist in time for partner kickoff. Thanks all :tada:

Maya: Thanks — I'll ping here when the GH issue has the template and labels. If anybody wants to pair on the initial README ping me.
